about: Hand review of the fixed evaluation spots (tools/review_spots.py pages). Per spot set, spot index -> tags and a note. 'unfair' = no agent can be expected to chop here with the current actions and training.

5.text: Starts right in front of a cave drop: a few steps forward and the agent falls in, and it has never learned to climb out of a cave. Every agent 0 logs.

27.text: Starts at the bottom of a ravine (water, dirt walls). Getting out needs pillaring or digging stairs; the actions have no block placing and training never teaches escaping. Every agent 0 logs.

56.text: Starts on sea ice facing open ice. Trees and a way up are behind the agent, but it never turns around to see them and gets lost on the ice. Every agent 0 logs.
